hero.title: G H Raisoni University, Chhindwara
hero.summary: G H Raisoni University offers a full-time agriculture honours degree at its Saikheda campus. The programme page describes eight semesters, an institutional field for practical learning, study tours and projects. Its audited ICAR term ends in November 2026, making renewal confirmation particularly important.

overview.heading: Agriculture study at the Saikheda campus
paragraphs: G H Raisoni University’s agriculture course is located at Saikheda in Madhya Pradesh. The official programme page describes a four-year full-time honours degree divided into eight semesters. It brings together soil science, plant breeding, microbiology and crop-health subjects with practical exposure.

The university describes field practice, trips, study tours and projects within agricultural learning. Its course page also discusses work with farmers and agricultural companies as a way to connect classroom study with the sector. Applicants should ask for the current fieldwork calendar and internship arrangements, alongside a written fee statement and the admission rules for their intended entry year.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The four-year full-time degree spans agricultural microbiology, soils, genetics and plant breeding, plant pathology and related subjects. The university describes field practice, projects and study tours.
programmes.eligibility: The undated university course page lists 12th Science in PCM/PCB/PCMB/Crop Science with 45% for open and 40% for reserved categories. NTA’s 2025 table repeats those thresholds; 2026 conditions need confirmation.

fees.note: A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at G H Raisoni University, Chhindwara for 2021-11-09 to 2026-11-08. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to GHRU
admissions.intro: The course page links to the university application portal. Its eligibility thresholds are corroborated by an NTA table explicitly for 2025, so they are not treated as a verified 2026 policy. Ask admissions to confirm the applicable selection route and subject eligibility for the new cycle.

steps.title: Confirm the current prospectus
steps.text: Ask the admissions office for the applicable intake, subject requirements and selection rules before submitting an application.

steps.title: Request a written cost statement
steps.text: Obtain tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation options and refund terms for the intended entry year.

campus.heading: An institutional field alongside study tours
campus.intro: The agriculture page describes a university field used for practice and lists field trips, study tours and projects. Specific crop acreage, laboratory capacities and residential arrangements were not verified from the agriculture-specific sources read.

facilities.name: Agriculture practice field
facilities.description: The university describes a field available for agriculture students’ practical learning.

practical_learning: The degree page identifies field trips, study tours and projects as practical elements.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: A current agriculture-specific scholarship schedule for GHRU was not verified. Request the scheme name, funding authority, category rules, renewal conditions and net payable amount in writing before relying on a concession.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The agriculture page lists potential sectors such as agricultural production, food processing and input industries. These are career possibilities, not a dated GHRU placement result. No agriculture-specific employer or salary statistics were verified.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation
recognition.text: The audited ICAR List II records G H Raisoni University, Chhindwara and the programme labels below from 2021-11-09 through 2026-11-08. This is the scope verified on 30 October 2026; it does not extend automatically to other qualifications or guarantee renewal.

faculty.intro: A current named agriculture teaching roster was not verified in the pages read. Request the department-wise faculty list, qualifications and teaching responsibilities from the institution.

faqs.question: Which GHRU campus is the agriculture course at?
faqs.answer: The official course overview identifies GHRU Saikheda. The audited institution name retains Chhindwara.

faqs.question: What is the duration and mode?
faqs.answer: The official programme page specifies four years, eight semesters and full-time study.

faqs.question: Which school qualifications are listed?
faqs.answer: The undated university page lists PCM, PCB, PCMB or Crop Science with category-based thresholds. NTA’s matching table is for 2025; confirm current rules.

faqs.question: Is a verified 2026 fee available here?
faqs.answer: No. A secondary calculated fee total was found, but no dated official tuition schedule was verified.

faqs.question: When does the audited ICAR term end?
faqs.answer: It runs from 9 November 2021 through 8 November 2026. A later renewal must be checked separately.

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at GHRU?
faqs.answer: Agriculture practice field: The university describes a field available for agriculture students’ practical learning.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for GHRU?
faqs.answer: https://admissions.ghru.edu.in/. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact GHRU?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: +91 91110 42900; Public email: info@ghru.edu.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.
